input: indexed glyph registry IDs and familiar compounds, optional lastSummonedFamiliar
output: replaces both sets; resolves each known glyph, skips unresolved part; reconstructs familiars; optional last familiar restored
preservation: Learned unlock set restored without learning/reward action; new HashSets prevent accumulation on repeated load.
application_limit: ResourceLocation.parse can throw before null lookup; absent last familiar does not clear prior field. Borrow finite known-ID progress restoration, not reward reexecution.

input: max/current mana, book_tier, glyph bonus, reserved mana
output: five setters receive typed numeric values from saved compound
preservation: Same capability loader mixes persistent upgrade-related book tier/bonus with active resource balances. This is real state restoration, not an accessor.
application_limit: Setter-side clamping not resolved here; this body alone does not establish all5 should survive death. Borrow semantic whitelist rather than copying all fields in a persisted object.

output: both long counters restored to capability fields
preservation: Preserves two mutually classified accumulated playtime histories, not a cooldown expiry. Missing/wrong-type primitive read uses native tag default semantics, not an explicit fallback branch.
application_limit: No runtime proof invalid negative totals normalized. Borrow audit accumulated counters by consumer meaning; key suffix/time type alone insufficient to classify permanent.

input: old/new research capabilities and old checkmarks compound
output: if both capabilities exist, serializes old into fresh NBTTagCompound then deserializes new; new map cleared and each boolean loaded
preservation: readFromNBT deeply inspected: copied checkmark values rebuild map; clone has no isWasDeath restriction, applies on all Clone events.
application_limit: Null capability path silently skips. Support reader not second credit. Borrow preserve task receipts using new owned NBT rather than entire ForgeData.

output: constructs InfectionStatus bound to LivingEntity; rejects other owner types with IllegalArgumentException
preservation: Ownership checked before creating state; -1 is explicit constructor input default distinct from arbitrary0.
application_limit: Infection is not permanent merit. Useful boundary for excluding timed state from death preservation; constructor side effects/duration semantics not inferred.

input: lastForm name, inventory children keyed by form, slot byte and complete item tags
output: unknown lastForm defaults NONE; each stored form resolves and each stack restored at unsigned slot
preservation: Item ownership separated by transformation form; slot byte &255 avoids negative signed interpretation.
application_limit: Per-entry unknown form/null inventories and out-of-range slot not guarded here, can throw. Borrow whitelist real source schema and preserve slot payload; no claim all malformed old worlds recover.

input: optional cycle/level/xp plus ability compounds keyed by unique identifier
output: level reset1 and xp0; existing keys override; known abilities load own data or checkDeactivation(false,false) if missing
preservation: Missing ability and missing entire abilities compound differ; cycle is not reset on absence. Distinct skill-object implementation, not generic Stats dispatcher credit.
application_limit: Do not assume defaulting all absent keys is safe in partial import. Borrow copy present source progress with explicit field type; avoid reinitializing valid unrelated new-player state.

input: casting IDs/slot/level, heart-stop accumulated damage, evasion hits, learned spell data and spell selection
output: restores active casting fields alongside learned spells and selection; SpinAttack explicitly not saved
preservation: Disk persistence != death permanence: active damage/evasion fields share loader with real learned progress. Full body inspected, no explicit migration fallback required.
application_limit: Do not use full serialized spell data for player death clone. LearnedSpellData nested decoder not counted separately here; retain distinction as direct design evidence.

input: entity-ID child keys and effect-ID keys with enabled/defaulttrue and amplifier/default0
output: clears settings; resolves familiar entity registry and only inserts known effect holder references; rebuilds effect maps per familiar
preservation: Unknown effect skipped independently without discarding other effects; fresh maps detach mutable saved configuration.
application_limit: Identifier.parse can throw and entity fallback registry behavior not established. Borrow per-field known-key selection rather than trusting arbitrary NBT root prefixes.

input: registered familiars with optional child data and known effect definitions
output: only enumerated current familiar definitions considered; absent child skips; absent amplifier uses definition.iesniumValue rather than hardcoded0
preservation: Different algorithm from legacy key enumeration: current registry/schema drives allowed keys and default amplifier; unknown saved effects cannot inject new settings.
application_limit: No conversion claimed between two readers. Borrow source-proven finite schema and meaningful defaults, not blanket prefix migration.

trigger: handlePlayerDataClone calls Stats.clone on new manager
input: old legitimate flag, per-skill and per-resource instances keyed by registered type
output: copies legitimacy; each matching new instance loads old instance saveToNbt; unknown/missing target skipped
preservation: Per-object serialized transfer avoids replacing entire stats manager and preserves ownership of new instances; actual body inspected.
application_limit: Do not count orchestration listener or uniform loop entries separately. Borrow preserve only audited permanent schemas; clone skill data may include transient ability state requiring Dynasty-specific filtering.

input: old portal map, Patchouli books, itemStorage, activeCheckpoint and statsStorage
output: putAll/addAll into new collections; checkpoint and statsStorage reference assigned
preservation: Independent storage object has actual retention of books and item storage, distinct from Stats instance serialization.
application_limit: ItemStack values/maps are shallow shared references and destination not cleared. Borrow explicit ownership review; own permanent Tag should copy rather than assume putAll is deep.

input: old ally sets/names, minion, discovered spells, maxTier, recentSpells, typed variable map and wasDeath
output: directly transfers selected collections; only variables with isPersistent(respawn) enter new spellData; then sync
preservation: Comments and body deliberately omit death-lost imbuements/command casting. Death boolean influences per-variable lifetime policy rather than whole serialized object copy.
application_limit: Collections assigned by reference, no deep-copy guarantee; isPersistent implementations not all verified. Borrow explicit permanent-field whitelist, not their shallow ownership behavior.

input: saved list in old root with item payload and original slot
output: removes source list; typechecks entries; parses item; attempts original empty slot then inventory.add then drop
preservation: Real fallback handles occupied/full inventory, retaining valid stack via final drop. Explicitly applies configured durability cost/default5 capped maxDamage-1.
application_limit: Source removed before validating list/entries, corrupt data can be lost. Durability change is upstream rule only; no new Dynasty death penalty authorized. Existing vanilla inventory clone must not be duplicated.

input: old MAX_HEALTH attribute and modifier DEFAULT_ID
output: if old attribute/modifier exist removes same ID at target then adds permanent modifier
preservation: Replacement by fixed identity avoids stacking duplicate permanent max-health modifier on target. No isWasDeath guard despite method name.
application_limit: Target attribute null not guarded. Borrow inspect actual event condition and replacement ownership, never assume name means death-only.
